name: M4
description: M4 is a large-scale, multi-generator, multi-domain, and multi-lingual benchmark dataset for detecting machine-generated text, aimed at improving automated detection systems to prevent misuse in various societal domains.
reputation: M4 is a well-known benchmark in machine-generated text detection research and is commonly used as a reference dataset for evaluating detectors across generators and languages.
notes: Dataset highlights challenges in generalizing detection to unseen domains and LLMs; publicly available.
